## Weekly Coffee Shop Performance Dashboard

A Monday-check dashboard should emphasize trend direction, product mix, and the week-over-week change in each category. For this dataset, the clearest visuals are a line chart for trends, a stacked bar chart for mix, and a small KPI strip for the latest week.

## Best Charts and Main Insights

### Recommended chart set
- **Line chart**: one line per category across the 4 weeks
  - Best for spotting steady growth and comparing pace across items
- **Stacked bar chart**: total weekly sales split by Cold Brew, Latte, Tea, and Pastries
  - Best for showing overall volume and category contribution each week
- **Heatmap or small-multiple sparkline cards**: one mini trend per category
  - Best for a quick Monday scan on a compact manager dashboard

### Main insights from the data
- **All four categories grew every week**, so performance is consistently improving.
- **Latte leads sales each week** and remains the strongest revenue driver.
- **Cold Brew shows the fastest growth rate** among beverages, rising from 120 to 160.
- **Pastries are also rising steadily**, suggesting strong attachment to drink orders.
- **Tea is the smallest category**, but it still shows reliable week-over-week growth.

### Weekly sales snapshot
Week | Cold Brew | Latte | Tea | Pastries | Total
2026-01-05 | 120 | 180 | 90 | 140 | 530
2026-01-12 | 135 | 175 | 95 | 150 | 555
2026-01-19 | 150 | 190 | 100 | 160 | 600
2026-01-26 | 160 | 205 | 110 | 170 | 645

### Manager-friendly dashboard layout
- **Top row KPI cards**
  - Total sales this week: **645**
  - Highest category: **Latte**
  - Fastest-growing category: **Cold Brew**
  - Best add-on item: **Pastries**
- **Middle row**
  - Left: line chart by category
  - Right: stacked weekly sales bar chart
- **Bottom row**
  - Small trend cards for each category
  - A short note area for Monday actions: inventory, staffing, promo focus

### Best Monday actions
- Keep **Latte inventory and staffing** slightly ahead of demand.
- Consider a **bundle offer** for Latte + Pastry to lift basket size.
- Watch whether **Cold Brew momentum** continues into the next 2–3 weeks.
- Maintain Tea as a smaller but stable menu item rather than a growth focus.

## Dashboard Build Plan

Phase | Goal | Key Tasks | Deliverable
Layout | Make Monday review fast | Add KPI cards; place 2 main charts; add short note panel | One-screen manager dashboard
Trends | Show week-over-week movement | Build multi-line chart; highlight latest week | Trend view with clear direction
Mix | Show product contribution | Add stacked bars; label total weekly sales | Category mix view
Action | Support decisions | Add inventory and promo notes | Monday action panel

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+layout+weekly+sales+line+chart+stacked+bar+example
Action: [Button: Chart ideas] https://www.google.com/search?q=best+charts+for+weekly+sales+dashboard

## Sources

- Chart selection guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/charts
- Data visualization basics: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/data-visualization-charts/
